Proposal I'm asking you to approve: a 14-day trial-extension + 10k token credit pool restricted to their sandbox project, with a moderate per-minute rate limit and audit logging enabled. No production keys, and we require that they sign an acknowledgment of the temporary extension (simple one-paragraph approval) — we'll capture that in HubSpot.

Rationale: keeps pilot momentum and preserves a likely mid-market deal; low dollar risk, high upside.

Risks: we must ensure the credits are scoped and time-boxed; also confirm billing/contract team is OK with unilateral short-term extensions for this segment.

Can you confirm yes/no and any edits? If yes, I'll notify Samir and attach the brief approval text for signature.
